note:
399 -> 397, both units from `get_diff` and `validate` saying what they accept and return.

Measured the way py_typecheck.yml prescribes: mypy 2.3.0 and NOTHING ELSE in the venv, --no-incremental, `-p odoo.tools`, in a `git archive` tree of HEAD plus this change. Two consecutive runs, 397 both times.

  misc.get_diff              custom_style was `str | bool = False`, so `True` was
                             representable, meant nothing, and reached
                             `html_diff += custom_style` -- TypeError, reproduced.
                             `str | None = None` says the same thing once.
  view_validation.validate   annotated `-> object`, which makes `@validate(...)`
                             a call on a non-callable to anything reading the
                             types. It returns a decorator over a Validator.

The `Validator` alias is deliberate over an inline `Callable[..., bool]`: the
shape is not the thing a reader of `_validators` is missing.
